FAQ

Quick answers.

Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?

No. Our team brings all equipment and products.

Can I reschedule my booking?

Yes, you can reschedule easily by messaging us before your slot.

How is the price decided?

It depends on the size of the space and the type of cleaning. You get a clear quote before we start.
